I often thought of the strong arm that brought out of bondage the children of Israel who were in Egypt, and verily thought the same was used in bringing out of bondage those who were in Babylon, and 1 trust 1 shall, as well as many' more, long remember, the kindness of the Lord in answering our prayers and giving us success on this occasion.
